description: Creates a social drop: a video clip post from an exercise, exercise group, workout, or program, or an AI card post (tip, fact, myth vs fact, insight, trend, quote, offer) from a topic. Use when the user wants to create social media content. Returns the new drop IDs. Nothing is posted publicly.

kind.description: Clip post: kind is omitted or "clip".
Clip post: kind is omitted or "clip".
Card post: one of the card kinds; topic is optional.

channel_preset.description: Social format. Sets aspect ratio, length and copy style. Clip posts: ig_reels, ig_stories, ig_carousel (Instagram square video), tiktok, yt_shorts, fb_reels, yt_longform, fb_post, linkedin_post, threads_post. Card posts: ig_post, ig_stories, fb_post, linkedin_post, threads_post. Single posts only; not used with source_ids. Example: "ig_reels".

kind.description: Post type. "clip" (default) = video post from a library item; needs source_type and source_id or source_ids. Card posts (AI-written image slides), with an optional topic: "tip", "fact", "myth_fact" (myth vs fact), "insight", "trend", "quote", "offer".

locale.description: Language for names and text, as a locale code, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE" or "de". Omit for the default language.

source_id.description: Clip posts: ID of one item of source_type, from list_team_exercises, list_team_workouts or list_team_programs. Use source_ids for several.

source_ids.description: Clip posts: up to 7 IDs of the same source_type. Makes one post per ID. Use instead of source_id.

source_type.description: Clip posts: what the video is made from. "exercise" = one exercise clip; "exerciseCollection" = an exercise group (circuit or sets); "workout" = a workout; "workoutCollection" = a program.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

title.description: Post title shown in Teams. Single clip posts only. Omit to use the source name.

topic.description: Card posts: what the post is about, up to 200 characters, e.g. "Mobility for desk workers". Omit to let the AI pick a topic.
